steps: Catalog started with the demo named; it is not in the default membership, and present once afterwards
Catalog lists "Reading a Wiki Page Without DNS" and it opens
The page shows the stored page and the six observations, with no frame, form or input
The Inspector compares the access paths: six observations, the failed resolution, the given endpoint and its origin
Observed, derived, inferred and hypothesized claims are separate sections; the inferred one states its assumption
Observation B (ordinary path) and C (given endpoint) open as Inspector objects with per-field warrants
